commit.message:
feat: Zendesk integration for age review parent contact (#70)

* feat: Zendesk integration for age review parent contact workflow

Adds Zendesk ticket lifecycle management for underage user cases:
- Create support tickets when moderators submit parent contact email
- Webhook handler for parent replies (auto-pauses clock, advances state)
- Resolution sync closes tickets when cases are cleared/denied
- Auto-close deadline expiry syncs to Zendesk
- Duplicate ticket guard prevents re-creation
- Graceful degradation when Zendesk credentials aren't configured
- Dedicated webhook secret (ZENDESK_AGE_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
- getDaysRemaining extracted to shared module
- Full pubkey logging in ReportWatcher (11 log statements)
- D1 index on zendesk_ticket_id for webhook lookup performance
- Defensive ticket_id parsing (handles string or number from Zendesk)

* fix: self-heal zendesk_ticket_id column on existing D1 tables

ensureSchema() now runs ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for zendesk_ticket_id,
matching the existing reporter_pubkey self-heal pattern. Prevents
deploy ordering issues on existing staging/prod databases.

commit.message:
fix: resolve SERVICE_API_TOKEN from Secrets Store before use (#72)

* fix: resolve SERVICE_API_TOKEN from Secrets Store before use

SERVICE_API_TOKEN is a Secrets Store binding requiring .get(), but was
used as a plain string, sending "Bearer [object Object]" to
moderation-service and causing 401 on all media moderation actions.

- Apply typeof/.get() pattern matching other Secrets Store bindings
- Decouple auth from transport (Bearer valid for both paths)
- Guard against null-resolved token (misconfigured secret)
- Add tests for string, binding, and null resolution

* refactor(worker): centralize secret resolution in moderation auth paths

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
feat: age review clock — 15-day under-16 moderation workflow (#67)

* feat: support X-Admin-Key header for local dev

* docs: add local dev setup script and documentation

* feat: age review clock — 15-day under-16 moderation workflow

D1 table, ReportWatcher hook, admin API, mobile-facing /v1/ endpoints
(NIP-98 auth), cron deadline checker with Slack alerts, and admin UI tab.

- Schema: age_review_cases table with state machine, clock pause, deadline
- ReportWatcher: creates case on NS-underageUser report, in-memory Set
  guards against duplicate creation race
- Admin API: CRUD at /api/age-review/cases (behind verifyAdminAccess)
- Mobile API: /v1/account/moderation-status and parent-contact endpoint
  matching divine-mobile PR #3531 contract
- Cron: auto-closes expired cases, Slack alerts for approaching deadlines
- UI: Age Review tab with case list, detail panel, moderator actions
- 23 test cases covering all exported handlers

Enforcement (ban/restrict via Keycast) deferred to Track C.

* fix: address review feedback — state transitions, note bleed, deep link, alert dedupe

1. Pass hex pubkey (not npub) in Age Review → Users deep link
2. Sync resolution note textarea when switching between cases
3. Enforce valid state transitions server-side via VALID_TRANSITIONS map
4. Dedupe approaching-deadline Slack alerts with last_alerted_at column

* fix: enforce state transitions on parent-contact endpoint, gate mobile restriction on moderator review

handleParentContact now validates against VALID_TRANSITIONS before
advancing state, preventing illegal jumps from open_reported or
needs_follow_up.

handleGetModerationStatus only returns restrictedMinorReview for states
where a moderator has acted. open_reported (pre-review) returns active,
closing the abuse vector where a single unsolicited report could restrict
any user before human review.

* fix: route under-13 age review restriction to support email

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>
